corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Default scrolling gestures and keyboard shortcuts are input/device guidance, not only Apple-common presentation guidance.

conditions: Same-orientation nesting can make interaction unpredictable and difficult to control.
exceptions: A horizontal scroll view may be nested in a vertical scroll view, or vice versa.

conditions: Same-orientation nesting can make interaction unpredictable and difficult to control.
Nesting horizontal scrolling inside vertical scrolling, or vice versa, is permitted because those orientations differ.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Orthogonal nesting clarifies the rule's scope; it does not exempt any same-orientation nesting from the avoidance guidance.

conditions: Define a page from the current view height or width.
Consider a small overlap to help people retain context between pages.
On most platforms, the page size can be defined and is typically the current view height or width.
An overlap such as a line of text, glyph row, or part of a picture can be subtracted from the page size to help preserve context.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve the source's most-platforms, can, and typically qualifications instead of requiring the page size to equal the view dimensions.

conditions: Use automatic where possible for toolbars, text outside Liquid Glass controls, and pinned table headers.
Use the default automatic style where possible.
It provides more opaque separation for top toolbars containing many controls, text outside Liquid Glass controls, and pinned table headers.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Do not narrow the general automatic-style preference to its listed opaque-separation cases; retain the explicit iOS/iPadOS/macOS platform priority.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The scroll-edge-effect section explicitly concerns iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

conditions: Use standard gestures instead for views with controls or dense information that require quick, precise scrolling.
In general, use standard gestures instead for views with controls or dense information that require quick, precise scrolling.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve the source In general qualification for gesture guidance on secondary content.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Keep modality tags aligned with the existing source-supported scope.

conditions: For a single list or content view taller than the display, use the Digital Crown for vertical scrolling.
For a single list or content view taller than the display, rotating the Digital Crown scrolls the content vertically.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Describe the system interaction supporting the vertical-scrolling preference, not a separate app implementation command. Also align the modality tag with the existing scope.

statement.en: Use vertically stacked tab views for page-by-page scrolling in watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSのpage-by-page scrollingには、縦に並べたtab viewを使う。

conditions: The system page indicator shows position within the current page and the set of pages.

statement.en: Use tab views for page-by-page scrolling in watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSのpage-by-page scrollingにはtab viewを使う。

conditions: When tab views are stacked vertically, people can rotate the Digital Crown to move through full-screen pages.
In that vertical-stack scenario, the system displays a page indicator next to the Digital Crown showing position within the current page and the set of pages.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Vertical stacking is a conditional arrangement with system behavior, not a universal prerequisite for tab-view paging. Also align the modality tag with the existing scope.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Keep modality tags aligned with the existing source-supported scope.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The conditional custom-indicator MUST preserves expected scrolling input behavior; retain its explicit custom-scrolling trigger.

conditions: Reveal a selection or insertion point that an app operation placed outside the visible area.
Return to a hidden insertion point when people begin entering text.
Follow a pointer that moves past the view edge during selection.
Reveal a selection before acting on it after people scroll elsewhere.
Scroll only as much as necessary to preserve context.
Automatic scrolling can help when relevant content is no longer visible; the following are example situations, not simultaneous prerequisites.
After an app operation selects content or places an insertion point outside the visible area, bring that location into view.
When people begin entering text at a hidden insertion point, return to it.
When the pointer passes the view edge during selection, scroll in its direction.
When people select content and scroll elsewhere, reveal the selection before acting on it.
In all cases, scroll only as much as necessary to preserve context; a partly visible selection does not need to be shown in full.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve the person's action and context while distinguishing alternative auto-scroll situations and the minimum-scroll boundary.

conditions: Avoid zoom levels that make content impractical, such as filling a screen with one text character.
Zooming until one text character fills the screen is an example that does not make sense in most situations.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain the source's most-situations qualification; its example does not establish an absolute zoom limit for every context.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Testing control legibility across contexts belongs to accessibility priority.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The scroll-edge-effect use condition is specific to the documented iOS/iPadOS/macOS behavior.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Per-pane edge-effect alignment explicitly applies to iPadOS and macOS split views.

previous.title: Prevent visionOS scroll-indicator overlap

statement.en: When necessary, increase tight visionOS content margins to prevent scroll-indicator overlap.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はtightなvisionOS content marginを広げてscroll-indicator overlapを防ぐ。

conditions: The visionOS indicator is thicker than its iOS counterpart and could overlap content.

current.title: Account for visionOS scroll-indicator size

statement.en: When necessary, account for the size of the visionOS scroll indicator.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてvisionOSのscroll indicatorの大きさを考慮する。

conditions: The visionOS indicator is small overall but slightly thicker than the iOS indicator.
If content uses tight margins, consider increasing them to prevent the indicator from overlapping content.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Keep the conditional size recommendation while preserving margin enlargement as a consider option.

conditions: One-screen pages clarify purpose and improve glanceability.
exceptions: Use variable-height pages judiciously and place them after fixed-height pages when possible.

conditions: One-screen pages clarify purpose and improve glanceability.
Use variable-height pages judiciously and place them after fixed-height pages when possible.
exceptions: Longer pages remain possible: the Digital Crown can move between shorter pages and scroll within a longer page, and the page indicator expands into a scroll indicator when necessary.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain the longer-page alternative and its system behavior; keep judicious use and optional ordering as contextual recommendations. Also align the modality tag with the existing scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0001.title: Support standard scrolling input

statement.en: Support standard scrolling gestures and keyboard shortcuts.
statement.ja: standard scrolling gestureとkeyboard shortcutをsupportする。

conditions: Preserve the systemwide scrolling behavior people expect across the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Retained the general input requirement and separated custom-indicator elasticity.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0003.title: Avoid same-orientation nested scrolling

statement.en: Avoid nesting a scroll view inside another scroll view with the same orientation.
statement.ja: 同じorientationのscroll viewを別のscroll view内にnestしない。

conditions: Same-orientation nesting can make interaction unpredictable and difficult to control.
exceptions: A horizontal scroll view may be nested in a vertical scroll view, or vice versa.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Retained AVOID and the perpendicular-orientation exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0004.title: Consider page-by-page scrolling

statement.en: Consider page-by-page scrolling when fixed-amount movement suits the content.
statement.ja: 固定量の移動がcontentに合う場合はpage-by-page scrollingを検討する。

conditions: Define a page from the current view height or width.
Consider a small overlap to help people retain context between pages.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Preserved MAY and recorded page sizing and optional overlap.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0005.title: Prefer automatic scroll edge effects

statement.en: Prefer the automatic scroll edge effect style in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、macOSではautomatic scroll edge effect styleを優先する。

conditions: Use automatic where possible for toolbars, text outside Liquid Glass controls, and pinned table headers.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Corrected page-wide scope to the three platforms named by the scroll-edge section.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0006.title: Apply one scroll edge effect per view

statement.en: Apply one scroll edge effect per view in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、macOSではviewごとに1つのscroll edge effectを適用する。

conditions: Each pane in an iPadOS or macOS split view may have its own effect.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Corrected platform scope and separated cross-pane height alignment.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0009.title: Avoid Look to Scroll for secondary visionOS content

statement.en: Avoid Look to Scroll for secondary visionOS content.
statement.ja: visionOSのsecondary contentではLook to Scrollを使わない。

conditions: Use standard gestures instead for views with controls or dense information that require quick, precise scrolling.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Recorded the control-density and precision conditions behind the secondary-content restriction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0010.title: Make similar Look to Scroll views consistent

statement.en: Make sure all similar visionOS views support Look to Scroll when one of them does.
statement.ja: 同種のvisionOS viewの1つがLook to Scrollをsupportする場合は、すべてでsupportする。

conditions: One view in a group of similar content views already supports Look to Scroll.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Retained the conditional Make sure directive as MUST and corrected the gaze modality.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0011.title: Prefer vertical scrolling for watchOS content

statement.en: Prefer vertical scrolling for watchOS content.
statement.ja: watchOSのcontentでは縦スクロールを優先する。

conditions: For a single list or content view taller than the display, use the Digital Crown for vertical scrolling.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Recorded the single-view and Digital Crown context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0012.title: Use watchOS tab views for page-by-page scrolling

statement.en: Use vertically stacked tab views for page-by-page scrolling in watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSのpage-by-page scrollingには、縦に並べたtab viewを使う。

conditions: The system page indicator shows position within the current page and the set of pages.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0012.review_note: Recorded the Digital Crown page-indicator behavior and separated optional page-height guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0013.title: Define clear visionOS Look to Scroll areas

statement.en: Define clear visionOS scroll areas for Look to Scroll.
statement.ja: visionOSのLook to Scroll用scroll areaを明確に定義する。

conditions: Prefer a scroll view that spans the full width or full height of the window.
When a scroll view is inset, provide clear boundaries that indicate where people need to look.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0013.review_note: Recovered the Define lead and recorded the full-span preference and inset-boundary fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0015.title: Make custom scroll indicators elastic

statement.en: Make sure custom scroll indicators use the elastic behavior people expect.
statement.ja: custom scroll indicatorで期待されるelastic behaviorを使う。

conditions: The app implements custom scrolling for a view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure directive separately from default input support.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0016.title: Use automatic scrolling to preserve place

statement.en: Use automatic scrolling when it helps people find or retain their place.
statement.ja: 人が位置を見つける、または維持する助けになる場合はautomatic scrollingを使う。

conditions: Reveal a selection or insertion point that an app operation placed outside the visible area.
Return to a hidden insertion point when people begin entering text.
Follow a pointer that moves past the view edge during selection.
Reveal a selection before acting on it after people scroll elsewhere.
Scroll only as much as necessary to preserve context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0016.review_note: Activated the automatic-scrolling lead and recorded all four source scenarios plus the minimum-distance constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0017.title: Bound scroll-view zoom appropriately

statement.en: Use appropriate minimum and maximum scale values when a scroll view supports zoom.
statement.ja: scroll viewがzoomをsupportする場合は適切なminimumとmaximum scale valueを使う。

conditions: Avoid zoom levels that make content impractical, such as filling a screen with one text character.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0017.review_note: Activated the conditional zoom-scale guidance and recorded its usability boundary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0018.title: Test soft scroll edge effects thoroughly

statement.en: Thoroughly test soft scroll edge effects for control legibility across contexts.
statement.ja: soft scroll edge effectでさまざまなcontextのcontrol legibilityを十分にtestする。

conditions: The app chooses soft instead of the default automatic style.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional testing requirement and corrected its platform scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0019.title: Limit scroll edge effects to floating interfaces

statement.en: Use a scroll edge effect only when scrolling content passes behind floating interface elements.
statement.ja: scrolling contentがfloating interface elementの背後を通る場合だけscroll edge effectを使う。

conditions: Use the effect for visual separation, not decoration or overlay-like darkening.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0019.review_note: Activated the only-use boundary and corrected its platform scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0020.title: Align split-view scroll edge effects

statement.en: Keep per-pane scroll edge effects at a consistent height in iPadOS and macOS split views.
statement.ja: iPadOSとmacOSのsplit viewではpaneごとのscroll edge effectを同じ高さに保つ。

conditions: More than one split-view pane uses a scroll edge effect.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0020.review_note: Recovered the per-pane alignment requirement with its iPadOS and macOS scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0023.title: Prevent visionOS scroll-indicator overlap

statement.en: When necessary, increase tight visionOS content margins to prevent scroll-indicator overlap.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はtightなvisionOS content marginを広げてscroll-indicator overlapを防ぐ。

conditions: The visionOS indicator is thicker than its iOS counterpart and could overlap content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0023.review_note: Activated the conditional margin adjustment without turning the example into a fixed measurement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0025.title: Consider one-screen-height watchOS pages

statement.en: Consider limiting each watchOS page to one screen height.
statement.ja: 各watchOS pageを1 screen heightに制限することを検討する。

conditions: One-screen pages clarify purpose and improve glanceability.
exceptions: Use variable-height pages judiciously and place them after fixed-height pages when possible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0025.review_note: Separated the optional page-height guidance from the tab-view recommendation and corrected its modality.

prior_batch_metadata.review_method: Rendered Apple HIG Scroll views guidance, default input, discoverability, nesting, paging, automatic scrolling, zoom, scroll edge effects, platform-specific indicators, Look to Scroll, Digital Crown behavior, and supporting prose were reviewed; two repeated live renders matched the updated main-content hash.
prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Completed Scroll views coverage; retained all fourteen existing IDs, recovered eleven atomic rules, corrected scroll-edge platform scope and Digital Crown and gaze modalities, and reviewed three conditional MUST directives.

review_method: Root reviewed 12 Best practices and Scroll edge effects rules; one helper independently reviewed 13 Platform considerations rules. Root checked the proposed platform corrections and independently verified five exact sentence proofs. Rechecked all three conditional MUST outcomes, alternative contexts, modality tags, and input/platform/accessibility priorities. Exact trace presence and semantic approval are separate checks.
unverified: SDK availability, Look to Scroll behavior, control legibility, and Digital Crown paging were not tested on devices.
The general custom-scrolling requirement is conditional; no tvOS-specific custom scroll-indicator capability was inferred.
The page-local API links and media were not independently evaluated, and former full-page prose was not retained.

extraction_verification.method: Isolated extraction; all canonical rule files and stable-ID registry matched byte-for-byte.
